basis: targeted settings regression with reviewed carry-forward of unchanged acquisition validation

source_review.summary: Changes remove public runtime/API path overrides, ignore obsolete saved paths, show serial entry only for manual devices, improve setup documentation and add guarded release replacement. Native acquisition/calibration/FFT, API acquisition/configuration, process supervision, dependency versions, runtime build recipes and CI are unchanged. The only Python worker change is the missing-API guidance message.

candidate_checks.packaged_target_workers: Both target runtimes passed extracted-package mock acquisition; Windows covers native and API workers.
candidate_checks.package_comparison: 952 of 966 files are byte-identical to the original 1.0.0 package. Changes are settings routing, manifest fields, missing-API guidance, documentation, package metadata and rebuilt native binaries/manifests. Executable instruction sections in both workers and bundled libusb are byte-identical; acquisition source, dependencies and build recipes are unchanged.
candidate_checks.local_packaged_runtime: This exact ZIP passed clean boot and bundled native-worker mock acquisition on Apple silicon. The settings regression suite also passed locally.

acceptance: Completed physical acquisition, controls, lifecycle, Desktop, disconnect/reconnect and endurance checks carry forward after source and executable-code comparison. Native worker selection is now automatic; obsolete saved path settings are covered by regression tests. No new physical Mac acquisition is claimed for this replacement ZIP.
